metadata.question: Did active fire detections in Sumatra and Borneo, Indonesia, increase in 2023 compared to 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about active fire detections in Sumatra and Borneo, Indonesia, comparing 2023 vs 2022. Strategy: 1. Use the MODIS Active Fire product (MODIS/006/1/MCD14DL) which provides daily fire detection data 2. Define polygons for Sumatra and Borneo regions 3. Filter collection for 2022 and 2023, count fire detections 4. Compare the counts to determine if there was an increase Data Quality Considerations: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Count valid fire detections to ensure we have data - Simple comparison of fire counts between years The MODIS Active Fire collection provides fire detection confidence levels, but for this simple comparison, we can just count all detections. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sumatra and Borneo regions var sumatra = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[95.0, -6.0], [106.0, -6.0], [106.0, 6.0], [95.0, 6.0], [95.0, -6.0]] ]); var borneo = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[108.0, -5.0], [119.0, -5.0], [119.0, 7.0], [108.0, 7.0], [108.0, -5.0]] ]); var region = ee.Geometry.MultiPolygon([sumatra, borneo]); // Get MODIS Active Fire data var fires2022 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/1/MCD14DL') .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2023-01-01') .filterBounds(region); var fires2023 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/1/MCD14DL') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2024-01-01') .filterBounds(region); // Check collection sizes var count2022 = fires2022.size().getInfo(); var count2023 = fires2023.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Fire Images: ${count2022}`); console.log(`2023 Fire Images: ${count2023}`); if (count2022 === 0 || count2023 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Count fire detections (each pixel with confidence > 0) var countFires2022 = fires2022.select('Confidence') .map(function(img) { return img.gt(0).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); }) .aggregate_array('Confidence') .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .getInfo(); var countFires2023 = fires2023.select('Confidence') .map(function(img) { return img.gt(0).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); }) .aggregate_array('Confidence') .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Fire Detections: ${countFires2022}`); console.log(`2023 Fire Detections: ${countFires2023}`); // Validate results if (countFires2022 === null || countFires2023 === null || isNaN(countFires2022) || isNaN(countFires2023)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Determine answer if (countFires2023 > countFires2022) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
